ECHO Studio — scripted demonstration audio

Ten original English dialogue turns, written for this prototype. They are a fixed
script, not a live AI debate. ECHO, Nova and Atlas share one synthetic source voice;
this demonstration does not provide distinct cloned or actor voices.

Generated offline with official piper-tts 1.8.0 and en_US-ljspeech-high.
Runtime: https://github.com/OHF-Voice/piper1-gpl (GPL-3.0; not distributed here).
Model: https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices/tree/main/en/en_US/ljspeech/high
Model card: https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices/blob/main/en/en_US/ljspeech/high/MODEL_CARD
Dataset: https://keithito.com/LJ-Speech-Dataset/ — public domain, per model card.
The model card was retrieved and checked on 2026-10-16. Existing prototype voice
configuration identifies the same LJSpeech high-quality, 22,050Hz model.

Only generated MP3 recordings and sample-aligned phoneme-to-viseme cues are shipped.
No synthesis runtime, model, API credentials or paid service is included.
Cues come from Piper's synthesis alignments and are mapped to the avatar's standard
viseme keys. Mapping and coarticulation are approximate; these are not measured
human performance or a claim of perfectly accurate lip synchronization.
No amplitude-only lip-sync is presented as phoneme-accurate.
